guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 有明的公開流程具有厭氧、無氧、好氧與生物膜過濾，部分出水另作回用。課程讓學徒區分水質處理鏈與再生水用途鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Ariake documents anaerobic, anoxic, aerobic and biofilm-filter processes, with a portion further treated for reuse. The learner separates treatment and end-use chains.
procedure: 先點選「分流污水入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「反應槽停留」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「A₂O內回流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qr改成3000 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4000 m³/d。與基準 3000 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「好氧區氨轉化」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「無氧區電子供體」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把硝酸氮改成25 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 71.5 kg COD/d。與基準 57.2 kg COD/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「厭氧區磷循環」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把ΔP改成4 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 kg P/d。與基準 4.5 kg P/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「生物膜過濾床」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用面積降到60 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4 m/h。與基準 3 m/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「回用水臭氧子系統」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把轉移效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 mg/L。與基準 3 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「建築沖廁需求配對」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「處理與回用儀表」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the separate-sewer influent measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the reactor retention measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the A₂O internal recycle measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qr to3000 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4000 m³/d. Compare with baseline 3000 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the aerobic ammonia conversion measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the anoxic electron donor measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only nitrate nitrogen to25 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 71.5 kg COD/d. Compare with baseline 57.2 kg COD/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the anaerobic phosphorus cycling measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ΔP to4 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 kg P/d. Compare with baseline 4.5 kg P/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the biofilm filter bed measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active area to60 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4 m/h. Compare with baseline 3 m/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the reuse-water ozone subsystem measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 mg/L. Compare with baseline 3 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the building-flushing demand measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the treatment/reuse instruments measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「分流污水入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「反應槽停留」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
在流路圖分開標示內回流與真正出水，避免重複計量。在離線場景為「A₂O內回流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「好氧區氨轉化」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「無氧區電子供體」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時量測溶解態與總磷、污泥含磷率及排泥量。在離線場景為「厭氧區磷循環」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時讀流量、濾前後水位及濁度，記錄停用濾格與反洗時段。在離線場景為「生物膜過濾床」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
量測尾氣並檢查溴化物與副產物資料，建立目標化合物驗證。在離線場景為「回用水臭氧子系統」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「建築沖廁需求配對」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「處理與回用儀表」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for separate-sewer influent; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for reactor retention; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Mark internal recycle separately from final effluent to avoid double counting. Build an offline evidence table for A₂O internal recycle; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for aerobic ammonia conversion; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for anoxic electron donor; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure dissolved and total phosphorus, sludge phosphorus fraction and wasting rate together. Build an offline evidence table for anaerobic phosphorus cycling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Read flow, upstream/downstream level and turbidity together; log offline cells and backwash periods. Build an offline evidence table for biofilm filter bed; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure off-gas, review bromide and by-product data and validate the target compound. Build an offline evidence table for reuse-water ozone subsystem; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for building-flushing demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for treatment/reuse instruments; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把回流水加到整廠外部出水會造成假性水量增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
厭氧區帶入硝酸鹽可能干擾生物除磷；先查回流與碳源。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
未扣反洗中的濾格會低估運轉負荷；先重算可用面積。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
水質氧化需求升高會降低目標物可用的氧化能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Adding recycled flow to external effluent creates fictitious water production. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Nitrate entering an anaerobic zone can disrupt biological phosphorus removal; inspect recycle and carbon first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Counting a backwashing cell understates operating loading; recompute active area first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Higher water-matrix demand reduces oxidation available to the target compound. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
